as_told.title: Ruwa school children see a UFO landing

plain: In 1994, at the Ariel School in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, a group of schoolchildren said they saw a silver craft come down from the sky and land in a field near their school. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, puts the number at 62 and points out that a uranium mine was nearby. If true, a craft landed in front of children close to a source of nuclear material. David Grusch, a man who speaks publicly about secret UFO programs, says about 100 children saw walking, human-like beings he calls NHI, short for non-human intelligence. A man named Karl Nell says beings showed themselves to the children in the middle of the day. A filmmaker, James Fox, says he investigated it himself for a work called The Phenomenon and calls it an alleged landing seen by about 66 children, and he stresses the message the children say they received: "you don't understand how special you are." Others add details: one speaker, Merrick, says the children's drawings were identical, while a writer, Peter Levenda, says their stories do not always match. The tellers disagree on the number of children and on whether beings were seen.
